native_retrieval.title: COVID-19 pandemic in Chandigarh - Wikipedia
native_retrieval.snippet: Ongoing COVID-19 viral pandemic in Chandigarh, India. The first case of the COVID-19 pandemic in India was reported on 30 January 2020, originating from China. The first case was recorded in this region on 19 March 2020. As on 24 May, total number of cases in Chandigarh was 225. * As on 7 June, total number of cases in Chandigarh was 318, including 40 active cases 5 deaths and 273 recoveries. * As on 16 June, total number of cases in Chandigarh was 365, including 58 active cases 6 deaths and 301 cures. * As on 29 June, total number of cases in Chandigarh was 434, including 79 active cases, 349 cures and 6 fatalities. * As on 16 July, total number of cases in the UT was 635, including 148 active cases, 476 recoveries and 11 fatalities. * As on 27 July, total number of cases in the UT was 910, including 320 active cases, 576 cures and 14 deaths.
